## BUNNY | Start here / 从这里开始

中文：按顺序上传视频与人物图；确认 `<Picture N>` 对应；粘贴本段专属英文提示词。时长自动匹配输入视频，无需手填秒数。

English: Upload the video and character references in order. Check the `<Picture N>` mapping and paste the English prompt for this clip. Duration follows the loaded video automatically.

**注意 / Important**：默认只启用参考图像1。需要更多图片时，先用底部的参考图像分组开关启用对应槽位，再上传并核对 `<Picture N>` 顺序。 / Only Picture 1 is active by default. Enable each additional image group with the picture-group controller before relying on its uploaded image.

**视频预处理 / Video preprocessing**：顶部 720P 开关打开为 720P，关闭为 480P。横竖屏自动识别，参考视频保持原比例，24 fps 固定。

# BUNNY | Six-section prompt guide / 六段式提示词指南

**中文**：这是一张写法提示卡，不会自动送入模型。先用 `h3-compact-motion-transfer` Skill 看完整段视频并生成专属提示词，再粘贴到右侧 Text 节点。`[方括号]` 只是占位说明，不可直接运行；角色数、图片数、镜头数都按实际素材增减。只描述核实过的画面。

**English**: This card is a guide, not the model input. Use BUNNY's `h3-compact-motion-transfer` skill to inspect the entire clip, then paste the finished clip-specific prompt into the Text node on the right. Replace every `[placeholder]`. Add or remove subjects, pictures and shots as needed.

```text
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> replaces [visually identified source person] in <Video 1>. Their appearance comes from <Picture 1>: [distinctive face, hair, clothing]. Keep this identity across the source shots.
[Repeat for each requested replacement.]
<Video 1> is the complete [measured duration] source clip. It supplies motion, camera, cuts and timing.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Replace [source-to-target mapping]. Preserve [requested setting and timing].

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - [target identity from picture].
<Video 1>: partially_preserved - [retain action/camera/timing; replace requested people].

detailed_description:
[Short verified setup. One brief sentence per real shot or coherent shot group. Preserve the actual end state.]

overall_soundscape:
[Verified sound only; if video-only, retain source audio separately in editing.]

non_diegetic_music:
[Requested music or N/A.]
```

**重点 / Key rule**: 图片锁外观，视频锁动作、镜头和时间；人物映射必须来自本段实际画面。 / Images define appearance; the video defines motion, camera and timing. Identify each source person from the actual clip.

widgets_values:
## BUNNY 自动画幅 / Automatic aspect ratio
输入视频强制读取为 24 fps。720P 开关开启时，横屏高 720 / 竖屏宽 720；关闭时使用 480。另一边按原比例计算。H3 输出按原视频比例与约 0.5 MP 像素预算计算，宽高取 32 的倍数。无需手填横竖屏。

The input is read at 24 fps. Switch on: 720 px short side. Switch off: 480 px short side. The other side preserves the source aspect ratio. H3 output follows that aspect ratio at about 0.5 MP, rounded to multiples of 32.

# BUNNY H3 Compact Motion Transfer  / 精简动作迁移

**中文**：上传本段视频和目标人物图；用 BUNNY 六段式 Skill 生成英文提示词，粘贴到提示词节点。视频定义动作、镜头和节奏；图片定义目标人物外观。输入视频按 24 fps 读取，输出帧数自动取不超过输入长度的 H3 合法帧数。音频 VAE 与音频解码在此视频专用版保持关闭；需要原声或配乐时，成片后另行合成。

**English**: Upload the source clip and target character images. Generate a clip-specific six-section English prompt with BUNNY's skill and paste it into the prompt node. The video defines motion, camera and timing; images define target appearance. Input frames are read at 24 fps. Output length automatically uses the largest valid H3 frame count that does not exceed the input clip. Audio VAE and audio decoding remain disabled for this video-only edition; add the original soundtrack or music in post.

**Credit / 来源**: Original H3 sampling and second-pass graph by 吃猪侠233 — https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1cVez6qEZS/ . BUNNY edition: compact prompt workflow, cleaned inputs, bilingual guide, output naming and automatic video duration.

**自动视频适配 / Automatic video adaptation**: 只用顶部 720P 开关选择短边 720 或 480；自动识别横竖屏，保持原视频比例。参考视频及生成画幅均自动适配；24 fps 不变。 / Use the single 720P switch to choose a 720 or 480 px short side. Source and output aspect ratio follow the uploaded clip automatically at 24 fps.

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Tifa from <Picture 1>, replacing the dark-haired fighter in the deep-green top in <Video 1>. Preserve her face, long loose dark hair, white top, black skirt, dark stockings, gloves, boots, and body proportions throughout the moving shot. She follows this fighter's continuous body and sword trajectory, including after the two fighters cross positions.
<Subject 2> is Lara from <Picture 2>, replacing the blond fighter in the black T-shirt in <Video 1>. Preserve her face, tied-back dark hair, charcoal long-sleeved top, tan trousers, brown straps, holster, and boots throughout the moving shot. She follows this fighter's continuous body and sword trajectory, including after the two fighters cross positions.
<Subject 3> is the indoor training hall from <Video 1>, with brick walls, marked dark floor, ceiling lights, warm wall lights, and the original spatial perspective.
<Subject 4> is the complete two-person sword performance from <Video 1>, including each fighter's individual movement path, sword handling, exchanges, spacing, pace, and camera relationship.
<Video 1> is the complete 9.292-second source video, filmed as one continuous moving shot.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Replace the deep-green-top fighter with <Subject 1> from <Picture 1> and the black-T-shirt fighter with <Subject 2> from <Picture 2>. Transfer <Subject 4> to the corresponding characters while preserving <Subject 3>, the continuous camera movement, framing, action order, and full 9.292-second timing.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (throughout): fully_preserved - Tifa's face, loose dark hair, white top, black skirt, dark stockings, gloves, and boots remain consistent along the deep-green-top fighter's complete trajectory.
<Subject 2> (throughout): fully_preserved - Lara's face, tied-back hair, charcoal top, tan trousers, straps, holster, and boots remain consistent along the black-T-shirt fighter's complete trajectory.
<Subject 3> (throughout): fully_preserved - retain the training hall, floor markings, brick walls, lighting, and perspective.
<Subject 4> (throughout): attribute_transfer - transfer each fighter's own sword movement, footwork, interactions, position changes, and timing to the mapped character.
<Video 1> (00:00.000–00:09.292): partially_preserved - retain the single moving shot and complete action while replacing both fighters.

detailed_description:
The camera moves continuously with the sword duel inside <Subject 3>. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> remain attached to their respective source fighters' body paths and swords for the entire shot.
00:00.000–about 00:03.000: <Subject 1> follows the fighter initially on the left; <Subject 2> follows the fighter initially on the right. Preserve their rapid opening exchanges, changing camera distance, and original timing.
About 00:03.000–00:06.500: The camera tracks their continuing close-range exchange across the training floor. Keep Tifa on the deep-green-top fighter's uninterrupted movement path and Lara on the black-T-shirt fighter's uninterrupted movement path as they turn and pass through each other's space.
About 00:06.500–00:09.292: The fighters cross and exchange screen positions. Tifa moves with her source fighter into the right foreground; Lara moves with her source fighter toward the left and farther from the camera. Continue this exact identity-to-body mapping through their final sword exchanges and the source's last frame.

overall_soundscape:
The source audio can be retained separately during editing.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A.
